name: Escovitch fish
steps: Season the tilapia and pan-fry in oil until golden on both sides.
Lift out the fish and set aside.
Add the sliced onion, carrot and bell pepper to the pan.
Splash in the vinegar with the allspice and simmer for a few minutes.
Spoon the pickled vegetables and liquor over the fish.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
